fields.Name: T265 - Knowledge Configuration Section Nav and Vector Setup
fields.Description: Exercises the KH configuration left-nav sections and the vector-setup progress stepper — a bespoke multi-section settings surface distinct from the analytics rail and other KH tools.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Knowledge Hub app (application switcher dropdown next to the logo) and click 'Configuration' in the left nav (fa-cogs icon). The Configuration screen has an inner settings rail (Pipeline, Vector Database, Full-Text Indexes, Embedding Models, Thresholds, Search Scopes, etc.). Confirm the default section renders, then click 'Vector Database' and confirm it shows the 3-step setup progress (Providers / Embedding Model / Vector Indexes) with a completion count. Then click another section (e.g. Pipeline) and confirm the inner content swaps while the outer header stays. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Configuration screen loads with an inner settings rail and swaps inner content when a different section is clicked
The Vector Database section shows the 3-step setup progress (Providers / Embedding Model / Vector Indexes) with a step completion count
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
